analyst.summary: Sterling & Wilson Renewable Energy is a global solar EPC and operations-and-maintenance provider that posted a net loss for FY26, including one quarter dominated by a large one-off financial swing. More concerning, a rating agency downgraded or withdrew ratings on a large chunk of the company's bank facilities in July 2026, and more than a quarter of promoter shares are currently pledged. We rate it a Sell: the global solar EPC opportunity is real, but the balance sheet and credit signals here need to stabilize before this looks investable on fundamentals.
